text:
sara (docs): Hey team — opened a changelog PR for the next release. Need eyes on the model catalog deprecation + migration notes.

PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/622
Docs preview (CI): https://deploy-preview-622--redwood-docs.netlify.app/changelog

sara (docs): Highlights —
- deprecate: redwood-1-small (deprecated 2026-04-15)
- migration: recommend redwood-2-small with small prompt tweaks
- added code snippets for SDK v1 -> v2 aliasing
- added note about quantized artifacts

kevin (devex): I can take a pass on the SDK snippet section. Saw one failing link in the preview (model alias anchor 404).

matt (eng): Will review the catalog compatibility assertions. Quick Q: do we need to mention tokenization diffs for older prompts?

sara (docs): yes — added a short section but it could be expanded. If we call out tokenization differences we should link to the tokenizer notes page.

julia (product): We need the deprecation messaging to match the customer comms draft. @sara can you add the migration timeline (30/60/90 days) and the recommended fallback policy?

sara (docs): added a 30/60/90 plan in the PR, and a suggested fallback mapping:

```
if model == "redwood-1-small":
    use "redwood-2-small" (preferred)
    else fallback to "redwood-1-medium" temporarily
```

kevin (devex): I ran md-lint locally — one failing rule: MD034 bare URL. I'll push a patch to convert raw URLs to refs.

matt (eng): Found one technical nit: the size/perf numbers for redwood-2-small look swapped with medium. I'll paste corrected table in a follow-up commit.

sara (docs): timing: we want this merged before the Tuesday release window (merge by 17:00 PT Monday). Need 2 approvals (eng + product) and docs owner. Anyone able to approve after fixes?

matt (eng): I can approve after my table fix and a green CI.

julia (product): I'll review the messaging after the md-lint patches.

deploy-bot: Preview deployed — https://deploy-preview-622--redwood-docs.netlify.app/changelog (status: succeeded)

kevin (devex): pushed md-lint fix in a new commit (GH: kevin/devex:fix/md-refs)

sara (docs): CI rerun — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions/runs/987654321

matt (eng): LGTM on the technical content, approving now. `gh pr review 622 --approve`

julia (product): Approved. :thumbsup:

sara (docs): Ok merging after GH auto-checks finish. Will tag release notes team and draft customer email.

sara (docs): merged at 17:02 PT — changelog entry included. Follow-ups: expand tokenizer migration guide (assigned), update SDK codeblock in quickstarts.

kevin (devex): I'll open the tokenizer guide PR with examples for Python/TS.

sara (docs): thanks all!
